---
title: "Sunapee Ice-off Dashboard"
format:
  dashboard:
    embed-resources: true  # bundles all assets into a single HTML file for easy sharing
---

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(DT)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 22))
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false

# Note: this path is relative to the tutorial/ directory.
# If you render from the project root, adjust the path accordingly.
lake_ice <- read_excel("../assignment/data/lake_ice_off_data.xlsx", sheet = 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: prep-data

sunapee <- lake_ice |>
  mutate(ice_off_doy = as.numeric(ice_off_doy)) |>
  filter(lake_name == "Sunapee",
         !is.na(ice_off_doy))  # remove rows where ice-off DOY could not be parsed

# Number of years with observations
num_years <- nrow(sunapee)

earliest_ice_off <- sunapee |>
  summarize(ice_off_doy = min(ice_off_doy, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pull(ice_off_doy)

latest_ice_off <- sunapee |>
  summarize(ice_off_doy = max(ice_off_doy, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pull(ice_off_doy)
```

<!--
Dashboard layout:
- "## Row" creates a horizontal row of cards. Use {height="X%"} to control how tall the row is.
- "### Column" creates a card within that row.
- Rows and columns together define the grid layout of the dashboard.
-->

## Row {height="20%"}

<!--
Value boxes display a single summary statistic prominently.
To create one:
  1. Set the chunk option #| content: valuebox
  2. Return a list() with at minimum a `value` field
  3. Optionally set `color`, `icon`, and `title`
Available colors: "primary", "secondary", "success", "danger", "warning", "info", "light", "dark"
Browse icon names at https://icons.getbootstrap.com/
-->

### Column

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Years of observations"

list(
  icon = "calendar",
  color = "primary",
  value = num_years
)
```

### Column

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Earliest ice-off (Day of Year)"

list(
  icon = "arrow-up",
  color = "success",   # green — earlier ice-off is "good" for open water
  value = earliest_ice_off
)
```

### Column

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Latest ice-off (Day of Year)"

list(
  icon = "arrow-down",
  color = "warning",   # yellow — later ice-off indicates longer ice cover
  value = latest_ice_off
)
```

## Row {height="60%"}

<!--
Cards in the bottom row: a data table on the left, a plot on the right.
Each "### Column" block becomes one card panel.
-->

### Column

```{r}
#| title: Data table
sunapee |>
  select(year, ice_off_doy) |>
  datatable(
    colnames = c("Year", "Day of Year"),
    options = list(dom = 'ftp', paging = TRUE)
    )
```

### Column

```{r}
#| title: Changes in ice-off Day of Year
#| warning: false  # suppresses geom_smooth() formula message

sunapee |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = ice_off_doy)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Ice-off Day of Year")
```
